Update the older figure, or state which calls it covers, so a reader does not take 4.7 s as the cost of one plan plus review.

title: Correct the attribution of the 9 refusals.
comment:
**Correct the attribution of the 9 refusals.**

The text says "The review refused 9 plans". That is not what the retained calls show. Six refusals follow a second review: `luke-10-33-r1`, `luke-10-34-r1`, `luke-10-34-r3`, `luke-10-34-r4`, `daniel-7-9-r1` and `daniel-7-9-r2`. Three refusals follow a re-plan with no second review call: `daniel-7-9-r3`, `-r4` and `-r5`. The last retained call for each of those three is a `scene_plan` call, and `ledger.json` lists three calls for each. The evidence checks therefore rejected the second plan.

The same wording appears in the "Refused with a blocker (correct refusal)" row and in `llm/context/SCENE-PREPARATION.md`. Say that the pipeline refused 9 plans: 6 after a second review and 3 at the evidence checks. This also matters for how you read the review's measured precision.
